exam_scheme.note: NEET-SS (Super Speciality) is the single eligibility-cum-ranking entrance examination for admission to Doctorate of Medicine (DM), Master of Chirurgiae (MCh), and DrNB Super Specialty courses across medical institutions in India, conducted by NBEMS. The examination is administered as a group-based Computer Based Test (CBT). Each group paper consists of 150 multiple-choice questions carrying 600 marks with a duration of 2 hours 30 minutes (150 minutes). Marking scheme: 4 marks for each correct response, deduction of 1 mark for each incorrect response (25% negative marking). All questions in a paper are drawn from the feeder broad specialty curriculum. Minimum qualifying standard: 50th percentile in the respective super specialty group.
